actual_derivation: For a fixed opponent profile, c_x^{-i} is constant. If player i uses target resource x, k_x=m-c_x^{-i}; p_x(k_x)=v_x/(b_x+1+c_x^{-i}). Therefore C_i(A_i,s_-i)=K_i(s_-i)-u_i(X\A_i,bar(s)_-i) and every fixed-opponent cost increment is the negative of the decoded utility increment. Weak ties, empty subsets and duplicate labels preserve these identities.

With c_x total source coverage and H_b(c)=sum_{l=1}^c 1/(b+l), sum_{j=1}^{m-c_x}p_x(j)=v_x[H_b(m)-H_b(c_x)]. Thus Psi=constant-Phi on every complete profile, and target potential gap minus the sum of unilateral cost increments equals the sum of source unilateral utility increments minus the source potential gap. An identity alone supplies no sign for this common deficit.

The independent same-theme Shapley theorem supplies Phi(tbar)-Phi(sbar)<=sum_i Delta u_i<=0. For arbitrary real b_x>=0, its proof applies pointwise in p to the normalized monotone submodular coverage C_p(U)=sum_{x in union(U)}v_x(1-p)^{b_x}; integrating gives v_x/(b_x+j) and v_x H_b(j). Negating through the bridge proves the complete target inequality Psi(t)-Psi(s)>=sum_i Delta C_i>=0 for every legal target profile. Both source objects are essential to this named transfer route and remain in one ALL edge.

The target also has an independent direct proof for any unit-weight nondecreasing costs: removing r_x users from a resource in the common action lowers potential by at most r_x p_x(m), while adding r_x users to a resource outside it raises potential by at least r_x p_x(1). The sum is precisely the fixed-start unilateral deviation sum. This does not identify social total cost with potential and does not transfer arbitrary sequential strategies.

The positive-coefficient interpolation proof is valid: D+1=9m(m+1) makes every low-degree Lagrange correction coefficient have magnitude <1 at A=b+m+1>=m+1. Coefficients of the truncated geometric series are 1; coefficients above degree m-1 are unchanged. Returning to z preserves positivity. The m=1 constant case and rational bit-length statement are separated.

The 13-client example preserves every chosen last-mover reply but changes the first mover ranking. Exact fresh Fraction arithmetic gives source root payoffs (6,11/2,11/2) versus target costs (5/2,2,2). Hence the same complete source SPE with root A is not a target SPE, exactly because opponents change across root branches and K_i no longer cancels.
